purpose: Cold store structure: concrete plinth, PU panel box, steel angle frame, hinged door, PV ground rack
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off'); ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,8)
# plinth
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.5),6,0.6,color='lightgray')); ax.text(4,0.7,'concrete plinth 2.6x2.6m',ha='center',fontsize=9)
# box walls
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1.5,1.1),5,4,color='wheat',ec='black')); ax.text(4,4.5,'PU panels 100mm',ha='center',fontsize=10); ax.text(4,3.9,'1 tonne crates on racks',ha='center',fontsize=9)
# door
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((3,1.1),2,2.5,color='lightblue',ec='black')); ax.text(4,2.2,'900mm door',ha='center',fontsize=9)
# canopy
ax.plot([1.5,7.5],[5.5,5.5],'k-'); ax.text(4.5,5.7,'canopy shade',fontsize=9)
# PV rack
ax.plot([7.5,9.5],[0.5,2.5],'k-'); ax.plot([7.5,9.5],[0.5,0.5],'k-'); ax.text(8.5,1.2,'PV rack',ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120)
